target_name: Tune From Measured Metrics, Never Preemptive Caps
source_quotes: The 5 check loop is fine I mean you will waste loops confirming it or how many loops is needed per prompt leave it.
overlap_check: Extends the same target as draft 28 (a second add-only update, applied after it). Built-in method_38 says measure before capping; this says stop measuring once it works.

add_heuristics.condition: a count or interval already gives acceptable behaviour on a real run
add_heuristics.action: leave it and move on to the next real issue

add_decision_rules.name: Stop verifying what works
add_decision_rules.condition: a loop interval, pass count or retry count produced acceptable behaviour on a real run
add_decision_rules.outcome: leave it; do not spend more cycles pinning its exact value unless it causes errors, timeouts or wrong results
